title: LQF-MGF: exponential demand tails with saturated logarithmic leaves

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the one LQF-MGF algorithm in proof.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^48; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=RLOG(n), the explicit rational lower logarithm routine of Section8.0, m=ceil(r/(4ell)), kappa=ceil(log2m)+1, dl=ceil((n+1+m*kappa-m(m-1)/2)/(m+1)), H=dl+m-1, binary widths lambda_i=dl+i for i<m and root width1, u=ceil(log2n), K=2^13(m+10u+100), exact source extraction and full odd/two-adic decoding) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. On every branch total charged sequential work is O(n^4 2^F(n)), F(n)=4sqrt(n)log2(n)+(1/8)sqrt(n)/log2(n)-16(log2n)^2, with the stronger main-branch (n>=2^48) bound O(n^(7/2)ell2^(m+dl)). Source costs, wider-key sorting, implemented lookups, addresses, initialization, failed attempts and resets are included. The envelope has exact growth index1/2 and holds jointly with all other claims. For n=1, the displayed logarithmic resource envelope is extended by its positive value at n=2; this leaves the asymptotic structured form unchanged.

For every N>=2 and secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the one LQF-MGF algorithm in proof.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^48; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=RLOG(n), the explicit rational lower logarithm routine of Section8.0, m=ceil(r/(4ell)), kappa=ceil(log2m)+1, dl=ceil((n+1+m*kappa-m(m-1)/2)/(m+1)), H=dl+m-1, binary widths lambda_i=dl+i for i<m and root width1, u=ceil(log2n), K=2^13(m+10u+100), exact source extraction and full odd/two-adic decoding) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. On every branch peak classical space is O(n^(3/2) 2^F(n)/log2(n)), F(n)=4sqrt(n)log2(n)+(1/8)sqrt(n)/log2(n)-16(log2n)^2 bits, with the stronger main-branch (n>=2^48) bound O(n2^H), including every retained full-label table, merge scratch, counter and decoder record. Its exact growth index is1/2, jointly with all other claims. For n=1, the displayed logarithmic resource envelope is extended by its positive value at n=2; this leaves the asymptotic structured form unchanged.

For every N>=2 and secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the one LQF-MGF algorithm in proof.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^48; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=RLOG(n), the explicit rational lower logarithm routine of Section8.0, m=ceil(r/(4ell)), kappa=ceil(log2m)+1, dl=ceil((n+1+m*kappa-m(m-1)/2)/(m+1)), H=dl+m-1, binary widths lambda_i=dl+i for i<m and root width1, u=ceil(log2n), K=2^13(m+10u+100), exact source extraction and full odd/two-adic decoding) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. On every branch peak accessible quantum workspace is O(n), including the full depth-first stack, boosted leaf register, physical source/data, modular and extractor scratch, implemented lookup ancillas, roots and reset wires. There is no QRAM or coherent bank. Its exact growth index is0, jointly with all other claims. For n=1, the displayed logarithmic resource envelope is extended by its positive value at n=2; this leaves the asymptotic structured form unchanged.

For every N>=2 and secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the one LQF-MGF algorithm in proof.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^48; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=RLOG(n), the explicit rational lower logarithm routine of Section8.0, m=ceil(r/(4ell)), kappa=ceil(log2m)+1, dl=ceil((n+1+m*kappa-m(m-1)/2)/(m+1)), H=dl+m-1, binary widths lambda_i=dl+i for i<m and root width1, u=ceil(log2n), K=2^13(m+10u+100), exact source extraction and full odd/two-adic decoding) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. On every branch total acquired source copies, including rejected labels, failed merges and aborted work, are O(n² 2^((1/4)sqrt(n)/log2(n))), with main-branch (n>=2^48) cap Q<=nCcap+K=O(n²2^m); the finite exhaustive branch acquires at most N(n+10) copies and is included only through the uniform asymptotic envelope. Its exact growth index is1/2, jointly with all other claims. For n=1, the displayed logarithmic resource envelope is extended by its positive value at n=2; this leaves the asymptotic structured form unchanged.

For every N>=2 and secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the one LQF-MGF algorithm in proof.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^48; otherwise r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=RLOG(n), the explicit rational lower logarithm routine of Section8.0, m=ceil(r/(4ell)), kappa=ceil(log2m)+1, dl=ceil((n+1+m*kappa-m(m-1)/2)/(m+1)), H=dl+m-1, binary widths lambda_i=dl+i for i<m and root width1, u=ceil(log2n), K=2^13(m+10u+100), exact source extraction and full odd/two-adic decoding) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. The proved malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the independent ideal-copy model. No positive robustness or impossibility of robustness is claimed. All four resource bounds hold jointly under this promise.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
